annotation_note: The initial goal candidates were supplied by the user and checked against the report. These annotations have not received independent human review and are not verified ground truth.

source.name: Shell Annual Report and Accounts 2025
source.printed_page_offset_note: Physical PDF page numbers do not have one constant offset from printed page numbers; use the per-evidence values.
source.attribution: Shell plc, Annual Report and Accounts 2025. Official source; report copyright remains with Shell plc.

annotations.normalized_statement: Become the world's leading integrated energy company.

evidence.excerpt: Our vision is to become
achieve our vision [E] to be the world's leading integrated energy company
achieve our vision to be the world's leading integrated energy company

annotations.rationale: The report explicitly names this as Shell's vision. It is an intended enterprise outcome, not a binding or time-bound target.
annotations.ambiguity: Vision is deliberately retained as a strategic-goal interpretation while being distinguished from a formal commitment.

annotations.normalized_statement: Deliver resilient long-term value and financial returns for shareholders.

evidence.excerpt: delivering resilient returns and rewarding our shareholders
deliver resilient returns through the cycle

annotations.rationale: Financial value and resilient shareholder returns recur as an enterprise outcome; individual financial targets are subordinate measures, not additional group goals.
annotations.ambiguity: The report expresses value creation through several targets and mechanisms. Do not equate any single KPI or cost target with the goal.

annotations.normalized_statement: Reduce emissions while advancing the energy transition.

evidence.excerpt: a target to become a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050
evidence.section: Progress against our longer-term targets — Less emissions

evidence.excerpt: more value with less emissions

annotations.rationale: The report states a group net-zero ambition and emissions targets in its strategy progress section.
annotations.ambiguity: The umbrella strategy phrase overlaps with value creation. Keep this outcome distinct only when its emissions intent is represented without duplicating the umbrella slogan.

annotations.normalized_statement: Build a more competitive and operationally efficient enterprise.

evidence.excerpt: a more competitive business as we focus on performance, discipline and simplification
evidence.section: This is Shell — Our performance culture

evidence.excerpt: We are transforming Shell into a leaner, more competitive organisation as we focus on performance, discipline and simplification.
We will continue to drive the transformation of Shell into a leaner and more competitive organisation

annotations.rationale: The report states this organizational outcome directly, but also presents performance, discipline and simplification as ways to deliver value.
annotations.ambiguity: May be an enabling strategy for SG-02 rather than a separate ultimate enterprise goal. Report primary-only and primary-plus-alternative scores.

annotations.normalized_statement: Operate safely and responsibly, doing no harm to people and preventing operational leaks.

evidence.excerpt: Goal Zero ambition: to do no harm to people and to have no leaks across operations
our Goal Zero ambition to do no harm to people and to have no leaks across our operations

annotations.rationale: The report calls Goal Zero an ambition and says it lies at the heart of Shell's plans and activities.
annotations.ambiguity: Could be treated as an overriding foundational commitment rather than one item in a compact strategic-goal set.

annotations.normalized_statement: Grow the integrated gas and LNG business; this is business-specific, not a separate enterprise-wide outcome.

evidence.excerpt: Grow our integrated gas and LNG business

annotations.rationale: It is a stated strategy for a business area. Preserve its StrategicGoal type and unit scope; do not promote it into the enterprise-level output set.
annotations.ambiguity: An organizational unit's own strategy can qualify as StrategicGoal under the ontology, even though this evaluation targets enterprise-level goals.

annotations.normalized_statement: Grow LNG sales by 4–5% annually through 2030.

evidence.excerpt: Grow LNG sales 4--5% (CAGR) per year through to 2030

annotations.rationale: This measurable business-specific target supports broader strategy and should not become an independent enterprise goal.
annotations.ambiguity: It is an intended outcome and could be a StrategicGoal at a narrower scope; the error being tested is abstraction and scope promotion.

annotations.normalized_statement: Achieve cumulative structural cost reductions of $5–7 billion by the end of 2028.

evidence.excerpt: a cumulative $5–7 billion by the end of 2028

annotations.rationale: A quantified financial target supports broader value creation; it is not a separate ultimate enterprise outcome.
annotations.ambiguity: A financial target can itself be meaningful strategy, but its subordinate status should remain explicit.

annotations.normalized_statement: Keep operated oil and gas asset methane emissions intensity below 0.2%.

evidence.excerpt: methane emissions intensity below 0.2%
evidence.section: Progress against our longer-term targets — Less emissions

annotations.rationale: This is a specific emissions measure supporting the broader emissions outcome.
annotations.ambiguity: The target is an important commitment but is not a distinct enterprise-level strategic goal.

annotations.normalized_statement: LNG Canada shipped its first cargo in June 2025.

evidence.excerpt: June 2025 saw the first cargo from the new LNG Canada facility

annotations.rationale: This reports a completed milestone, not a future outcome.
annotations.ambiguity: The milestone may evidence progress toward a broader business goal; it does not create one.

annotations.normalized_statement: Shell has world-class trading and supply capabilities.

evidence.excerpt: world-class trading and supply capabilities

annotations.rationale: A capability can enable strategy but is not itself an outcome pursued.
annotations.ambiguity: Do not turn competitive advantages or strengths into goals without an explicit pursued outcome.

annotations.normalized_statement: Shell operates across more than 70 countries.

evidence.excerpt: across more than 70 countries

annotations.rationale: A description of current scale is not a strategic goal.
annotations.ambiguity: A descriptive fact may support contextual interpretation but must not be rewritten as a target.

annotations.normalized_statement: People acting on behalf of Shell must behave according to its Code of Conduct.

evidence.excerpt: The Shell Code of Conduct explains how employees, contractors

annotations.rationale: This is a governance rule/obligation, not an outcome to pursue.
annotations.ambiguity: The complete obligation continues beyond this short evidence anchor; provenance is checked against the full source page.

annotations.normalized_statement: Shell expects energy demand to grow in 2026 while transition signals remain uncertain.

evidence.excerpt: In 2026, we expect energy demand to keep growing, the pace of the transition to remain uncertain

annotations.rationale: A market outlook and uncertainty statement is context, not a goal.
annotations.ambiguity: Forward-looking language is not sufficient evidence of a deliberately pursued outcome.

annotations.normalized_statement: More value with less emissions is the report's umbrella strategy summary, not an additional goal duplicating its components.

evidence.excerpt: Our strategy is to deliver more value with less emissions
deliver more value with less emissions in a changing energy system

annotations.rationale: Do not emit repeated umbrella wording as a separate goal when it collapses value creation and emissions into one slogan.
annotations.ambiguity: Could reasonably be treated as one integrated overarching goal; retain this alternative in the annotations and report merge/split outcomes.
